description: A ground-level photograph depicts a wide, calm natural watercourse, likely a river, under a lightly cloudy blue sky. The water's surface reflects the sky and the surrounding trees, showing gentle ripples. The immediate foreground on the left bank is covered with vibrant green grass and some taller, lighter green reeds or sedges. On the far bank, a dense line of deciduous trees and shrubs forms a natural riparian zone, extending into a rolling green landscape in the background. The image serves as an illustration for "Natural & semi-natural water courses" as defined by EUNIS class C2.5, which includes natural streams of water typically wider than 10 meters.
